quickFixes.headline: Experiment with Question Hooks

contentPillars.name: Tech Question/Polls
contentPillars.description: Posts posing questions or polls related to tech, data structures, and software development choices.

topPosts.captionSnippet: Asks about data structure usage for SaaS, engaging developers to share their preferences. The goal is to gather insights from fellow developers.
Asks devs whether to build frontend or backend first to build their project. This type of discussion is focused on engaging with the dev community.

contentPillars.name: MRR/Monetization
contentPillars.description: Posts focused on ways to generate monthly recurring revenue (MRR) through apps and development strategies.

topPosts.captionSnippet: Suggests easy app ideas to make $10k/month, highlighting the gamification of various niches. It prompts discussions on effective strategies to get recurring monthly revenue.
Highlights the possibility of reaching $10k MRR with a smaller audience paying a nominal monthly fee. It triggers a conversation on the feasibility and reach of specific monetization strategies.

contentPillars.name: AI/Future Tech
contentPillars.description: Posts on future technology, including AI and development trends. This covers AI marketing, AI wrappers, and vibe coding.

topPosts.captionSnippet: Expresses love for vibe coding and hate for vibe debugging, highlighting the asymmetry in coding processes. This post sparked an discussion about coding and debugging.
Suggests building AI exclusively for marketing as a trillion-dollar idea. The post generated a lot of discussions about the potential application of AI in marketing.
Predicts the end of AI wrappers and promotes building OpenClaw/Clawdbot wrappers instead. This post promotes new approaches in AI tech.

analysis.pillarInsight: High-engagement posts focus on AI and future tech; plain text tips alone are not as effective.
